main_text.p: I. Jesus Christus è Cœlo missus Mediator, Propheta, Sacerdos & Rex evangelizari mundo debuit. Nam unus est Mediator Dei & hominum, homo Christus Jesus, qui se ipsum dedit redemptionis, pretium εἰς μαρτύριον τοῖς καιροῖς ἰδίοις in testimonium temporibus propriis, 1. Tim. 2:5,6. Quòd se redemptionis pretium dedit, argumentum est illius testimonii, quo homines con-Iesu Mediator mundo evangelizari debuit

page.notes: Marginal notes at right beside the final paragraph are partly cut and illegible in places: rendered as "Jesu Mediator mundo evangelizari debuit" with doubtful readings. Lines 29–61 of the italic list are a numbered thesis series, kept as running text. Greek phrase in the first paragraph is approximate. Catchword "teftatur," is the start of the next page's first word.
